Review Markdown files only: README, docs, REVIEW.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, rules and skill
documentation. Each diff includes complete changed sections where Git can identify them. Check
those sections against the repository for stale claims, contradictions, and references to missing
files, commands or settings.

Search for names, values and steps that the change renames or removes, then read the relevant
context. Do not read whole long documents when the changed sections provide enough context.
